description:
The Cancer iChart Archive app is open on the Welcome screen. Your task:
1. Tap 'Search For Drug Interactions'.
2. On the Cancer Drugs list, find and select 'Ibrutinib' (use the A-Z index to jump to 'I').
3. Tap 'Next' to proceed to Co-medications.
4. On the Co-medications list, find and select 'Fluconazole' (use the A-Z index to jump to 'F').
5. Tap 'Next' to see the Results.
6. Tap the arrow icon on the result card to open the Interaction Details page.
7. Verify you can see the 'Interaction Details' page showing the drug names, quality of evidence, and a detailed description of the interaction.
